notes: The public-API scenario isolates the IEEE 1516.1-2025 §5.3.3 source-refinement guard: with ownership acquisition pending for attribute A, a requester may unpublish unrelated attribute B, a later attempt to acquire B fails as AttributeNotPublished, and unpublishing A fails as OwnershipAcquisitionPending. Owner and requester ownership queries are supplemental state controls, not additional direct mappings. The adapter supplies the provider, endpoint, two-attribute FOM, names, callback model, and logical-time implementation. The native 30-assertion development-profile case passed ten exact repeats; the current-source installed-package portable C++ primary/contract passed 4/4 across evoked/immediate callbacks. Java parity compiles against the official API-only JAR but has no provider-runtime evidence. This is not a conformance claim and excludes provider-specific service-report file checks.
